release_notes: Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.5 expands the language selector from 6 named languages to 57 named languages plus Auto-detect. Existing English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese options remain available, with added support for languages including Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, and many more. Translate to English remains available. This update does not change the transcription engine, speaker diarization pipeline, conversation reconstruction, licensing, activation, portal integration, payments, updater behavior, exports, or existing legal content.
